name: inline-images
description: Shows images inline in the transcript: attached images above your prompt, image tool results (Read, screenshots) under their call, with a full-size viewer pane

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: auto: kitty graphics on kitty/Ghostty, truecolor half-blocks elsewhere (WezTerm, tmux, ...). image: always the kitty-protocol Image. halfblock: always half-blocks.

maxRows.title: Max image rows
maxRows.description: Tallest an inline tool-result image may be, in terminal rows

thumbRows.title: Thumbnail rows
thumbRows.description: Height of the thumbnails drawn above a prompt you attached images to

cellAspect.title: Cell aspect
cellAspect.description: A terminal cell's height over its width (about 2 for most fonts)
